sections.content: String several parts of the day together with commas to sketch out a whole day: time word, then what you do, repeated for each stretch of the day.

items.spanish: Délben dolgozom, délután szabad vagyok, este otthon vagyok.
items.english: At noon I work, in the afternoon I'm free, in the evening I'm home.
In the morning I study, in the evening I read.

sections.content: Each clause keeps its own time word up front — Hungarian doesn't reuse 'and then' the way English strings a day together. Just comma, next time word, next fact.
